reserves.name: PYUSD backing held for MoonPay PYUSDx issuance
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Paxos Trust Company, N.A. (PYUSD issuer); MoonPay Digital Assets Limited (PYUSDx issuer)

sources.label: MoonPay PYUSDx holder and counterparty terms

reserveReview.rationale: MoonPay terms define PYUSDx as backed by PYUSD and prescribe one PYUSD per token for minting and redemption. The 100% slice records the disclosed backing asset, not a measured reserve-coverage ratio. No public issuer wallet census or token-specific reserve-to-liability examination was retrieved. Upstream PYUSD assurance does not verify MoonPay holdings or PYUSDx liabilities.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer-defined single-asset 1:1 PYUSD backing; no independent quantity reconciliation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The disclosed reserve asset is PYUSD; the reserve amount, custody structure, encumbrance and allocation against all local liabilities are not independently established.

providers.name: MoonPay Digital Assets Limited (issuer-designated PYUSD receiving addresses; custodian undisclosed)

sources.label: MoonPay PYUSDx holder and counterparty terms

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Terms expressly deny any ownership, beneficial, trust, custodial or proprietary reserve interest and restrict redemption to eligible counterparties. Receiving PYUSD at issuer-designated addresses does not establish complete custody coverage, segregation, encumbrance limits or insolvency priority.
